messages.subject: Marginal likelihood computation when method = "MHRM"
parts:
Dear Phil/all,

I just wanted to ask if anyone could suggests references/explain how is the marginal likelihood computed under the MHRM estimation in the mirt function. I understand the CDLL that is displayed during the estimation (it's also explained in Cai's papers), but can't seem to find any reference explaining how the (high-dimensional) integral over the latent variables is computed without using quadrature points.

Many thanks,
Best,
Camilo

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Marginal likelihood computation when method = "MHRM"
parts:
The marginal likelihood is computed by drawing values from posterior distribution of theta and averaging (read: marginalizing) over these draws. You might have some luck parsing the package source code for this (but be warned, I document pretty much nothing due to the "bus factor" of 1.....)

Phil
